_meta.status: Best-effort AI-assisted translation for the SIH26003 prototype — not yet reviewed by a native speaker or community linguist. Treat as a solid starting draft, not a certified translation; please correct before any real deployment in Meghalaya.
_meta.script: Khasi is written in the Latin alphabet, as used here.
_meta.fallback: Any key missing here falls back to English automatically (see i18n/index.ts).

common.aboutThisGame: Kaba la ïa kane ka dulïióh
common.personalBest: Phi la ïalade sha kaba bha bad bha!
common.takeBreakTitle: Ban sngew jubor ïong ka nadan?
common.takeBreakBody: Phi la leit dulïióh na kawei ka por bha. Ïong ka nadan ka lah ban rong.
common.clinicalNote: Ka SmritiSetu ka rong ïa ka jingïatylli bad ka jingiaid sha ka jingpynithuh ïa kaba thrang na ka por. Kane um dei ka jingïaid duna. Khang ïa u nong-lakriah.

roles.choosePrompt: Mynta u/ka ei kin pyndonkam ïa ka SmritiSetu?

onboarding.chooseLanguageBody: Toh ïa ka ktien kaba phi lah ban bteng ïa ka bha.
onboarding.consentBody: Ka SmritiSetu ka rung ïa baroh ki jingiathuh jong u nongshongthait — ka kyrteng, ki khel ki la khelh, bad ka jingïarap — namar ka device kani lang. Ym don ki jingiathuh uba wan shaphrang na kane ka device haba phi ym la pyndep ban sync.
onboarding.consentPointStorage: Baroh ka data ka rung ha kane ka device, ha ka jingdon ka internet ne cha.
onboarding.consentPointControl: Phi la lah ban export ne pynïap baroh ka data naduh sha naduh na ka Admin Panel.
onboarding.consentPointNotDiagnosis: Ka SmritiSetu ka iasoh ïa ka jingsngew jong ka mynsiem — kane ym long u nongkren jingpang.
onboarding.consentAgree: Nga la pule bad nga ïaid
onboarding.setupPatientName: Kaba u/ka nongïatiit u kyrteng eiei?
onboarding.setupCaregiverPin: Thoh kawei ka PIN ba 4 ïa u nongïalam
onboarding.setupCompleteBody: Ka SmritiSetu ka la pyndep sa ban leit dulïióh, na ka internet ne cha.

errorBoundary.title: Ka kam ïa jem
errorBoundary.body: Ka SmritiSetu ka la ïalam da ka jem. Ym la mang un ïa ka data — phi la lah ban leit sha pynkut bad buit shuwa.

caregiverAuth.title: Login jong u Nongïalam
caregiverAuth.enterPin: Sar ïa ka PIN jong phi
caregiverAuth.wrongPin: Kane ka PIN um khlaiñ. Buit shuwa.
caregiverAuth.tooManyAttempts: Bun shibun ka jingbuit ba khlaiñ. Buit shuwa ha {{seconds}} second.
caregiverAuth.scanQr: Ne scan ïa ka QR code jong phi

adminAuth.title: Login jong Admin
adminAuth.wrongPin: Kane ka PIN um khlaiñ. Buit shuwa.

adminPanel.resetAllDataBody: Kane ka pynïap ïa baroh ki data ha kane ka device. Thoh "{{word}}" ban jia jan.

levelSelect.title: Pdiang ka Level
levelSelect.body: Ym don khaih shuwa — pdiang ïa katkumba level ban dulïióh. Sha ka jingdulïióh sngi baba, ka SmritiSetu ka pynithuh jan ïa kawei ka level.

patientHome.todaysSetBody: Lai ki dulïióh ba la pdiang ïa mynta

domains.orientation: Ka jinghikai mo bad kata sngi

reminders.title: Mynta
reminders.noneToday: Ym don shuwa ban pyndep mynta. Long ka bha!
reminders.label: Kane ka dei ïa ei?

familyManager.title: Ïing bad ki Khmat
familyManager.body: Thap ki gambar, kyrteng bad jingong ïa ka Naam Yaad.
familyManager.name: Kyrteng
familyManager.noMembers: Ym don shuwa u nong ïing kaba la thap.

dashboard.title: Dashboard jong Nongïalam
dashboard.domainBalanceBody: Kumno u/ka {{name}} u/ka leit dulïióh ïa baroh ki bynta 5
dashboard.cognitiveInsightsBody: Kawei ka jinglaitluid statistical ïa katkata bynta, na ka jingdulïióh jong u nongïatiit ha lade — ym long ka jingïatylli ar dieng khmat, bad ym rah shuwa ïa ka data jong u briew shuwa.
dashboard.adaptiveLogBody: Baroh ka jingthrew level bad ka jingïalam
dashboard.disclaimer: Kane ka dashboard ka pynithuh ïa ka jingïatylli ban khang bad u nong-lakriah. Kane um dei ka jingïaid duna.
dashboard.noData: Ym don shuwa bunom data — leit dulïióh kai kai lyngba.

smriti-cards.name: Smriti Cards
smriti-cards.instructions: Toh ar cards ban thied ïa kiba don ka jingïatylli. Buit shuwa ban mut hate ka gambar ha hangne.
smriti-cards.clinicalMapping: Ïalam bad ka jingtylli gambar ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingmut kaba treikam (MoCA) bad ka jinghikai ktien (ADAS-Cog).

smriti-katha.name: Smriti Katha
smriti-katha.instructions: Sngap kawei ka khanatang bajrong, namar toh gambar ban dang ki jingkylli baba khie.
smriti-katha.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingmut jong ka por bad ka jingmut ktien (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) lyngba ka khanatang sngi baba.

naam-yaad.name: Naam Yaad
naam-yaad.instructions: Ka gambar jong u/ka ba phi tip ka la ïoh lang. Toh ïa u kyrteng khlaiñ.
naam-yaad.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jinghikai kaba don donkam lyngba ki gambar ïing ba tarik (MoCA/ADAS-Cog).

dhyan-dhaam.name: Dhyan Dhaam
dhyan-dhaam.tagline: Wad ïa ka pattern ba khlaiñ
dhyan-dhaam.instructions: Toh ïa baroh tile kiba khlaiñ bad ka pattern kaba pynithuh ha khwan.
dhyan-dhaam.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingjop mynsiem bad ka hukum (MoCA, ADAS-Cog).

ginti-dhyan.name: Ginti Dhyan
ginti-dhyan.instructions: Toh ïa ki number na kaba jrong haduh, ha ka jingdur jong ka grep.
ginti-dhyan.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingjop mynsiem bad ka jingmut ba don kam (MoCA digit span).

awaaz-pehchan.name: Awaaz Pehchan
awaaz-pehchan.instructions: Sngap bha. Toh ïa ka button namar lada phi la sngap ïa ka ktien ne jingong ba dei.
awaaz-pehchan.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingjop mynsiem lyngba jingsngap (MoCA), khlem jingpule.

dinacharya-sequence.name: Dinacharya Sequence
dinacharya-sequence.instructions: Sun ïa ki card gambar sha ka jingdur baba pyndep bynta sngi.
dinacharya-sequence.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka ïarap jong ka jingpyndep (IADL).

bazaar-list.name: Bazaar List
bazaar-list.instructions: Sngap ïa ka list bazaar, namar toh khlem kiba don ha ka grid.
bazaar-list.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingmut bad ka jingpyndep (IADL).

ghar-ka-kaam.name: Ghar ka Kaam
ghar-ka-kaam.instructions: Toh ïa u hukum ïing, namar toh ïa ka kaam kaba pyndonkam.
ghar-ka-kaam.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jingïarap hukum-kaam (IADL).

aakar-milan.name: Aakar Milan
aakar-milan.instructions: Wad ïa kaba tukra baba pynjrong bha ïa ka pattern.
aakar-milan.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jinglong bad ka jinghikai (MoCA, ADAS-Cog).

chaya-khoj.name: Chaya Khoj
chaya-khoj.instructions: Peit ïa kaba jong, namar toh ïa ka khadduh kaba khlaiñ.
chaya-khoj.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jinglong khmat (MoCA), khlem jingpule.

naksha-jodo.name: Naksha Jodo
naksha-jodo.instructions: Ïatylli ïa ki tukra ban pynshong ïa ka gambar. Long por lem.

aaj-ka-din.name: Aaj Ka Din
aaj-ka-din.instructions: Khie ïa kajingkylli bajrong ba dei ïa mynta.
aaj-ka-din.clinicalMapping: Ka pyndonkam ïa ka jinghikai por bad jaka (MoCA orientation). Kane ym dei jingkai jing haiñ, ka jingpule sngi baba.
